# Goderich Heating & Cooling

> Goderich Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Goderich, Huron County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 524-0177  |  Email: contact@goderichheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://goderichheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Goderich, Clinton, Blyth, Holmesville, Port Albert, Auburn
